Grade modeled as a role-split absorbing Markov chain (grades 35-70 plus graduated and out, annual step), estimated from prospects.db snapshots (fangraphs + mlb_pipeline pooled to one grade per player per year), Laplace-smoothed; graduated = debuts.json, out = inactive.json, and a still-active player's last year is censored (no fabricated transitions). Payoff = the clemens_2026 table value of the grade a player graduates from. Low grades are option-dominated (45 FV hitter OPT% about 60%, thick data); high grades run low or negative OPT% because they are thin (60 FV about 221 hitter obs) and grade mobility at the top is net-downgrade risk the frozen intrinsic ignores. SURFACED 2026-07-05 as an opt-in OPT% column on the PROSPX active board (#optpct; payload surplus.opt_pct via value_framework.published_opt_pct, snapped by FV tier). Provisional: negative high-grade values are shown honestly.

models.notes: SHIPPED 2026-07-04 (Tier 2). Quantile-maps each source's grade distribution onto FanGraphs FV on the OVERLAP (players graded by both), per role per cycle, so coverage is controlled for and only a true scale bias remains (a top-only outlet is not called hot for skipping the low tiers). No scale equivalences are assumed; thin cells pool the source's overlap across years (flagged). The reference maps to itself (identity) and recomputation is deterministic. ADOPTED 2026-07-05 as the LIVE consensus scale: consensus.build_timeseries applies build_remapper() per source before aggregation (default-off in the core so unit fixtures are unchanged; on at the pipeline entrypoints via ADOPT_NORMALIZED_CONSENSUS), preserving source weights, the single-source pull, dropped-off shrinkage and forward-fill. Per-source published grades on the card are untouched; only the consensus scale moves. Note: the append-only history (metric_snapshots, farm_grade_history) gains a scale seam at the adoption date and eFV settles over one run. 2026 cycle flags mlb_pipeline and espn as grading materially higher than FanGraphs on shared players.
